c10.note: The saved page confirms the 2025 annual report PDF is hosted at that URL. No saved page or header check gives the 4.7 MB size, and my own size check was blocked.

c11.note: This is practical advice, not a checkable fact. The saved pages confirm the landing page and the SEC-hosted copy of the same long report both exist. The report text is about 300k characters, so calling it very large is reasonable.

c23.note: Confirmed: JPMorganChase filed its 10-K for the fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2025 with the SEC on Feb 13, 2026 (Business Wire release; EDGAR accession 0001628280-26-008131), so the 'unconfirmed' hedge is unneeded.

c26.note: JPM puts out a shareholder annual report with the Chairman/CEO letter (published Apr 6, 2026) and separately files a Form 10-K with the SEC (Feb 13, 2026). Both cover FY2025.

c28.note: The 2025 annual report came out Apr 6, 2026, and JPM usually publishes it in early April. No 2026 report is expected before about April 2027, so the 2025 edition is the latest as of Nov 2026. The April 2027 date is a projection from that pattern.
